## Diagnostic rows

If you can reproduce it, please turn on **Diagnostic rows** in the mod's
options, do it again, and paste what the mod manager's `[ERRS]` screen
shows.

This matters more than it sounds: on a phone there's no console, so
`[ERRS]` is the only place the mod can report anything. If the host turns
to face you and nothing happens, this is usually the *only* evidence of
what went wrong.
